text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza, I noticed two
horse girls having a serious conversation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: An interview? For me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You are frequently favored as the
first or second favorite in your races, are you not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They wish to inquire about the secret behind that rock-solid popularity.
What do you say? Would you be willing to accept?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind doing the interview.
However, even if asked for a "secret"...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In my view, it is simply that I excel at playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I minimize danger to the utmost degree, the risks are low,
and consequently, instances of defeat are rare.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My popularity merely stems from that sense of stability in "not losing."
There is truly nothing profound enough worth speaking of in an interview...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your modesty is indeed a virtue. However,
from where I stand, it also feels somewhat regrettable.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Regrettable, you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Popularity is the tangible manifestation of everyone's expectations.
It is not something acquired so easily.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It would be well worth your while to ponder once more
upon why it is you who carries that mantle.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Worth pondering once more, huh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found Hayahide!!
Oiii!! Hayahideeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You were talking with the President just now, right!
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a request for an interview has come in for me.
They supposedly want to know the secret to my popularity, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She confided to her two friends what she had
just discussed with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Safety measure? Oh, that's that thing, right?!
The fence you put up so things don't get dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwah, you're so amazing, Hayahideee! That's how
you're alwayz protekting everyoneee...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's a "safety barrier."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Besides, Hayahide is probably overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Popularity is basically just the mood of the moment. No need to read that deeply into it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What...? Overthinking it, you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That is completely untrue!! It's not as if my head got bigger from overthinking or anything like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Nobody said anything about that, though?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be fine! Hayahide, you're amazing after all!
It'll definitely turn out to be a great interview~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... I certainly hope so.
